paper.title: UFO2: The Desktop AgentOS
paper.central_claim: UFO2 is a practical Windows Desktop AgentOS whose Host/App hierarchy, native API and GUI fusion, knowledge retrieval, speculative execution and PiP isolation improve robust, efficient, safe and non-disruptive desktop automation.

gap.author_gap: Monolithic screenshot-driven CUAs miss native app semantics and interrupt user input.
gap.checked_gap: Authors acknowledge UFO1 host/app hierarchy, AgentS experience retrieval and OmniParser visual grounding. Fixed AWM and SkillWeaver establish reusable workflows and tool libraries. Residual is Windows-native integration with typed manually exposed APIs, hybrid controls, guarded batching and PiP, not first hierarchy, memory or GUI/code mix.
